lessons.title: Matrices

explanation_sections.title: Matrices
explanation_sections.body:
A matrix is a rectangular arrangement of numbers in rows and columns. Matrices of the same order can
be added by combining corresponding entries. For a 2 × 2 matrix [[a,b],[c,d]], the determinant is ad −
bc.

questions.prompt: State the order of the matrix with rows (2,1,5) and (3,4,6).
Explain why a matrix with determinant zero has no ordinary inverse.
questions.correct_answer: The inverse formula requires division by the determinant.
